<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

Nemotron-H’s ModelOpt mixed-precision override rejects flashinfer_cutedsl for checkpoints containing W4A16_NVFP4 experts, even when the existing W4A16 opt-in is enabled.
Allow this supported explicit configuration, following the Qwen precedent in #39126 and using the implementation already introduced in #35120. Preserve the automatic Marlin selection established by #33543.

## Modifications

- Allow --moe-runner-backend flashinfer_cutedsl when SGLANG_FLASHINFER_CUTEDSL_NVFP4_W4A16=1 on SM100-family GPUs.
- Preserve auto → marlin, explicit Marlin support, and Nemotron’s existing --moe-a2a-backend none requirement.
- Update the validation error and add regression coverage for backend selection, the environment flag, unsupported hardware, and A2A restrictions.

## Accuracy Tests

GSM8K, 200 questions, thinking enabled, using the existing Nemotron CI evaluator.
B200, TP1, SGLang 0.5.21 / FlashInfer 0.6.18, Nemotron-3.5-Lightning-30B-A3B-NVFP4;
temperature 0, seed 42, concurrency 32, 16,384-token cap, speculation disabled.
Results from the confirmation run:

| Backend | Correct | Accuracy |
|---|---:|---:|
| Marlin | 188/200 | 94.0% |
| CuTe DSL W4A16 | 190/200 | 95.0% |

No degradation observed in this run. The small difference is consistent with noise.


## Speed Tests and Profiling

### End-to-end serving

B200, TP1, SGLang 0.5.21 / FlashInfer 0.6.18, same NVFP4 checkpoint, concurrency
32, static 57,600 shared-prefix + 6,400 new input tokens and 400 output tokens,
8 warmup + 160 measured requests, AIPerf 0.12.0.

| MoE backend | Output tokens/s | Speedup |
|---|---:|---:|
| Marlin | 1,576.63 | 1.00× |
| CuTe DSL W4A16 |  2,199.04 | 1.40× (+39.9%) |

Both measurements completed all 160 requests with zero errors and 64,000 output 
tokens.

### Isolated grouped-GEMM microbenchmarks

A separate B200 study invoking kernels directly (FlashInfer 0.7.0.post1).
Replayed nine expert-assignment patterns captured from Nemotron-3.5-Lightning,
using its checkpoint's NVFP4 expert weights and BF16 activations. These exercise
Nemotron's actual MoE workloads and help explain the serving speedup above.
Logical up K→N: 2688→1856; down: 1856→2688.

Selected cases below. Times are median milliseconds per grouped-GEMM invocation,
covering all assigned experts for one projection, without activation or final
combine. 
T is the number of input tokens before routing, and each case replays its full
captured per-expert assignment vector. These measurements help illustrate 
the kernel-level gains behind the serving speedup.

| Case | T | Projection | Marlin (ms) | CuTe DSL (ms) | Speedup |
|---|---:|---|---:|---:|---:|
| A | 32 | Up | 0.0439 | 0.0242 | 1.81× |
| A | 32 | Down | 0.0430 | 0.0231 | 1.86× |
| F | 16 | Up | 0.0675 | 0.0431 | 1.57× |
| F | 16 | Down | 0.0665 | 0.0448 | 1.48× |
| G | 2,129 | Up | 0.8267 | 0.1986 | 4.16× |
| G | 2,129 | Down | 0.7558 | 0.1988 | 3.80× |
| H | 14,896 | Up | 4.1495 | 0.8799 | 4.72× |
| H | 14,896 | Down | 3.4406 | 0.8886 | 3.87× |
| I | 15,436 | Up | 4.2833 | 0.9067 | 4.72× |
| I | 15,436 | Down | 3.5455 | 0.9163 | 3.87× |

CuTe DSL was faster in every tested case: **1.44–4.72×** for pure up/down GEMMs
and **1.67–5.10×** for up+ReLU² (fused CuTe DSL versus Marlin plus standalone
activation), across all nine measured patterns.

## Checklist

- [X] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [X] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [X] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [X] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [X] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

files.patch:
@@ -9,6 +9,7 @@
     model_config_of,
     resolving_view,
 )
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
 from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_platform
 
 logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
@@ -74,9 +75,17 @@ def _nemotron_h_overrides(server_args: Any, hf_config: Any) -> dict:
     if has_w4a16_moe_layers:
         if cfg.moe_a2a_backend != "none":
             raise ValueError("W4A16_NVFP4 MoE layers require --moe-a2a-backend=none.")
-        if cfg.moe_runner_backend not in ("auto", "marlin"):
+        # CuTe DSL supports BF16 activations with NVFP4 weights when opted in.
+        use_cutedsl_w4a16 = (
+            cfg.moe_runner_backend == "flashinfer_cutedsl"
+            and get_platform().is_sm100
+            and envs.SGLANG_FLASHINFER_CUTEDSL_NVFP4_W4A16.get()
+        )
+        if cfg.moe_runner_backend not in ("auto", "marlin") and not use_cutedsl_w4a16:
             raise ValueError(
-                "W4A16_NVFP4 MoE layers require --moe-runner-backend=marlin."
+                "W4A16_NVFP4 MoE layers require --moe-runner-backend=marlin, "
+                "or flashinfer_cutedsl on SM100-family GPUs with "
+                "SGLANG_FLASHINFER_CUTEDSL_NVFP4_W4A16=1."
             )
         if cfg.moe_runner_backend == "auto":
             overrides["moe_runner_backend"] = "marlin"

@@ -1646,7 +1646,7 @@ def test_nemotron_h_w4a16_moe_rejects_a2a_backend(self):
         with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "moe-a2a-backend=none"):
             _nemotron_h_overrides(server_args, hf_config)
 
-    def test_nemotron_h_w4a16_moe_rejects_non_marlin_runner(self):
+    def test_nemotron_h_w4a16_moe_explicit_runner(self):
         from sglang.srt.arg_groups.model_overrides.nemotron_h import (
             _nemotron_h_overrides,
         )
@@ -1659,10 +1659,62 @@ def test_nemotron_h_w4a16_moe_rejects_non_marlin_runner(self):
                 }
             }
         )
-        server_args.moe_runner_backend = "flashinfer_trtllm"
+        cases = [
+            ("auto", "none", False, {"moe_runner_backend": "marlin"}, None),
+            ("auto", "none", True, {"moe_runner_backend": "marlin"}, None),
+            ("marlin", "none", False, {}, None),
+            ("marlin", "none", True, {}, None),
+            ("flashinfer_cutedsl", "none", True, {}, None),
+            ("flashinfer_cutedsl", "none", False, None, "moe-runner-backend=marlin"),
+            ("flashinfer_trtllm", "none", True, None, "moe-runner-backend=marlin"),
+            ("flashinfer_cutlass", "none", True, None, "moe-runner-backend=marlin"),
+            ("flashinfer_cutedsl", "deepep", True, None, "moe-a2a-backend=none"),
+            ("flashinfer_cutedsl", "flashinfer", True, None, "moe-a2a-backend=none"),
+        ]
+        for runner, a2a, w4a16_enabled, expected, error in cases:
+            with (
+                self.subTest(runner=runner, a2a=a2a, w4a16_enabled=w4a16_enabled),
+                override_platform(is_sm100=True),
+                override_platform(is_blackwell=True),
+                envs.SGLANG_FLASHINFER_CUTEDSL_NVFP4_W4A16.override(w4a16_enabled),
+            ):
+                server_args.moe_runner_backend = runner
+                server_args.moe_a2a_backend = a2a
+                if error is not None:
+                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, error):
+                        _nemotron_h_overrides(server_args, hf_config)
+                else:
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        _nemotron_h_overrides(server_args, hf_config),
+                        {
+                            "quantization": "modelopt_mixed",
+                            "attention_backend": "trtllm_mha",
+                            **expected,
+                        },
+                    )
 
-        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "moe-runner-backend=marlin"):
-            _nemotron_h_overrides(server_args, hf_config)
+    def test_nemotron_h_w4a16_cutedsl_rejects_non_sm100(self):
+        from sglang.srt.arg_groups.model_overrides.nemotron_h import (
+            _nemotron_h_overrides,
+        )
+
+        server_args, hf_config = self._nemotron_h_args(
+            quantized_layers={
+                "backbone.layers.1.mixer.experts.0.up_proj": {
+                    "quant_algo": "W4A16_NVFP4",
+                    "group_size": 16,
+                }
+            }
+        )
+        server_args.moe_runner_backend = "flashinfer_cutedsl"
+        for is_blackwell in (False, True):
+            with (
+                self.subTest(is_blackwell=is_blackwell),
+                override_platform(is_sm100=False, is_blackwell=is_blackwell),
+                envs.SGLANG_FLASHINFER_CUTEDSL_NVFP4_W4A16.override(True),
+                self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "SM100-family GPUs"),
+            ):
+                _nemotron_h_overrides(server_args, hf_config)
 
     def test_step3p_hierarchical_cache_golden(self):
         # SWA-hybrid arch: the mini config needs layer_types/sliding_window.
